nodes.label: Atomic write via temp file and rename
nodes.norm_label: atomic write via temp file and rename
nodes.rationale: lqosd watcher does not accept a symbolic link, so write a temp file in the same dir then rename.

nodes.label: SHA-256 content hash skip
nodes.rationale: If the output hash is unchanged, do not write and do not reload.

nodes.label: Performance rules
nodes.rationale: Router API calls and LibreQoS reload are the slow parts: poll routers in parallel tokio tasks, keep API sessions open, timeouts per call, stable sorted output.

nodes.label: LQoSync UpdateCSV (Rust tool)
nodes.rationale: Replaces updatecsv.py; reads MikroTik subscriber data and writes LibreQoS shaping input for 2.0-2.2 and 3.x from one TOML file.

nodes.label: Operational rules
nodes.rationale: Only one sync tool in apply mode per shaper, start shadow, back up live files before cutover/upgrade.

nodes.label: /run/lqos/bus 0777 safety caution
nodes.rationale: Production bus is world-writable; block sockets with strace inject and never call validate_shaped_devices.

nodes.label: LibreQoS upgrade 2.2 to 3.x
nodes.rationale: First upgrade keeps source=shaped_devices (v3_pair, same format as v2); switch to libreqos_network after a stable period.

nodes.label: Session 2026-10-31 project setup and v3 simulation
nodes.norm_label: session 2026-10-31 project setup and v3 simulation

nodes.label: ADR-0001 One model, many writers
nodes.rationale: One crate, one circuit model, one writer per target; collector/speed rules/topology/validator shared. Pair-only lacks v3 strict gate, stable IDs, VLAN/MPLS; network-only needs a 2.2 converter anyway. Status accepted.

nodes.label: ADR-0002 v3 target selection
nodes.rationale: Auto-select per cycle from version and v3 topology source; fixed TOML target overrides. Rejected fixed-only (upgrade writes wrong format) and write-all (confusing). Status proposed pending v3 test shaper.

nodes.label: Secret files (*_file, mode 0600 root)
nodes.rationale: Passwords and tokens never go in TOML; tool refuses to start if secret file mode/owner is wrong.

nodes.label: Read-only router access rule
nodes.rationale: The tool never writes to routers; credentials live in 0600 secret files, not in TOML.

nodes.label: Operator decisions pending (speed rules, crate location, repo URL)
nodes.norm_label: operator decisions pending (speed rules, crate location, repo url)

nodes.label: Open item: speed rule direction and units
nodes.norm_label: open item: speed rule direction and units
nodes.rationale: updatecsv.py reads first rate as download and unitless as Mbps; RouterOS reads rx/tx router-side and unitless as bps. Operator must choose.

nodes.label: install.sh one-line installer
nodes.rationale: Starts in shadow, never touches Python service, LibreQoS files/packages, or routers; aborts if check fails.

nodes.label: shadow mode
nodes.rationale: Installer starts in shadow so the tool writes no LibreQoS files until the operator compares output and does the cutover.
